landing.heroSubtitle: Páginas walks alongside your emotional wellbeing with one small reading a day — a metaphor, a reminder, an exercise. Made to accompany therapy, never to replace it.
landing.heroNote: One piece a day. Takes under a minute.
landing.previewBody: The body holds tension like a fist clenched for hours. You don't need to force it open — just remind it, slowly, that it's allowed to rest now.
landing.feature1Body: Short, calm content chosen for your theme and your moment. No noise, no rush.
landing.feature2Body: We forget instructions, but we remember stories. The metaphor is the anchor format of Páginas.
landing.feature3Body: Your therapist can seed themes after each session, and the app reinforces them through the week.
landing.therapistTitle: Páginas keeps the conversation going between sessions.
landing.therapistBody: Invite your clients with a code, seed each session's themes, and let the app reinforce them, gently, through the week. The clinical care is yours — the continuity is ours.
landing.disclaimerBody: Páginas is a wellbeing and support tool. It is not a medical device and does not replace psychological or psychiatric care.
landing.finalBody: Create your account in seconds. Your first piece is waiting.
landing.footerRights: A calm space for your journey.

review.title: Content review
review.intro: All 365 Páginas pieces, gathered for professional review. Each piece awaits validation. Download the spreadsheet to note corrections, removals or suggestions — it has dedicated columns for that — and return it to the team.

legal.disclaimerHeading: Not a replacement for clinical care
legal.disclaimerBody: Páginas is a wellbeing and emotional support tool. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose and it does not provide treatment. It does not replace psychological, psychiatric or medical care.
legal.crisisBody: If you are in intense distress or at risk, seek help immediately. In Portugal: SOS Voz Amiga 213 544 545 / 912 802 669 / 963 524 660. In an emergency, call 112.
legal.rgpdBody: Mood records and journal entries are sensitive health data. We collect the minimum necessary, store it in the European Union and do not share it. You have the right to access, correct and delete your data — just ask.
legal.contactBody: For any question about privacy or your data, contact the Páginas team.
